payout_quote: Both you and your friend can earn a reward through the referral program if your friend spends $50 with their Venmo Debit Card within 30 days of starting the referral process. ... The reward amount is $10 cash ("Reward"). ... Rewards will be credited to the Venmo Account of participants within 30 days after qualifying to receive the Reward.
timing: $10 cash credited to the Venmo account within 30 days after the referee's $50 in debit-card purchases (usually ~14 days)
eligibility: Referrer and referee each need a Venmo account in good standing + Venmo Debit Card; referee must never have been issued/used a Venmo Debit Card; referee spends $50+ in purchases (ATM withdrawals and quasi-cash excluded) within 30 days of the referral link creation; referrer cap of 10 rewards ($100 max)
steps: Get a Venmo Debit Card referral invitation in-app
Share your referral link privately with a friend (not in public forums - against terms)
Friend signs up for the Venmo Debit Card via the link and completes identity verification
Friend spends at least $50 in purchases with the Venmo Debit Card within 30 days
Both receive $10 cash credited to Venmo within 30 days
catches: Your friend must spend $50 of THEIR OWN money on debit-card purchases (not ATM withdrawals, not P2P transfers, not digital-wallet funding) before either of you gets the $10.
The reward can take up to 30 days to credit after qualifying.
Referral links may only be shared privately with people you know - public posting can void the referral and the reward.
Referrer is capped at 10 rewards ($100 total).
The general Venmo P2P referral bonus ($5/$10) is campaign-set and not documented in static official terms - this route is the Debit Card referral only.
